title: CARTA Global Constitutional Collection Queue
scope: 193 current UN Member States and two UN non-member observer states. Other ISO country/area records remain separately catalogued and are not included in this sovereign/observer collection denominator.
status_policy: A queue entry is a research assignment, not an assertion that a constitutional text has been acquired, verified, cleared or published.

global_sources_for_discovery_only.name: United Nations current member list
global_sources_for_discovery_only.use: Verify UN membership; not a constitutional text licence.

global_sources_for_discovery_only.name: UN observer states
global_sources_for_discovery_only.use: Verify observer-state classification; not a constitutional text licence.

global_sources_for_discovery_only.name: Comparative Constitutions Project / Constitute
global_sources_for_discovery_only.use: Discovery and cross-checking only. Current terms prohibit commercial use of site content; do not copy constitutional texts into CARTA under these terms.

global_sources_for_discovery_only.name: WIPO Lex
global_sources_for_discovery_only.use: Research/discovery only. Terms permit reproduction for academic, research and non-commercial purposes, and may require additional third-party permissions.

global_sources_for_discovery_only.name: Laws.Africa content licensing
global_sources_for_discovery_only.use: Potential commercial supplier for participating African jurisdictions; obtain a written country/package/use licence and confirm scope/pricing.

global_sources_for_discovery_only.name: PollsAfrica constitutional-source inventory
global_sources_for_discovery_only.use: Discovery only: its 54-country metadata, adoption/amendment dates and official-source links may be reused with attribution. Its CC BY 4.0 metadata licence does not license the underlying constitution texts. The inventory states that 47 of 54 records have PDFs, 27 hosted on the official publisher site and 20 hosted by PollsAfrica where the source allows reuse. Confirm every exact underlying document, version and CARTA reuse scope independently.
